items.text: Giants QB Jaxson Dart suffered sprained MCL (X-rays negative, MRI Tuesday); ruled out of game, expected to miss some time; positive overall. Jameis Winston entered.
items.why: Knee injury on hit; initial exams indicate MCL sprain.
items.implication: Miss time; Winston starts remainder/near-term. Giants offense impacted.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip/groin) officially inactive for Monday Night Football vs. Giants.
items.why: Hip/groin soreness; trending wrong way pregame per reports.
items.implication: Featured role expands for Davante Adams and remaining Rams WRs.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/snaps for Adams and depth WRs like Mumpfield/Atwell.

items.text: Eagles TE Dallas Goedert suffered sprained MCL vs Titans; expected to miss a few weeks. Zach Ertz signed to PS with intent to promote.
items.implication: Miss multiple weeks; Ertz likely elevated for TE work.
items.opportunity: TE targets to Ertz/other Eagles pass-catchers.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels (dislocated left elbow) underwent imaging; consulting specialists. Marcus Mariota expected to start vs Seattle. Ruled out Week 3 per reports.
items.implication: Mariota starts near-term; timeline TBD, possibly longer.
items.opportunity: Commanders skill players volume with backup QB.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams (hamstring) expected to miss some time; week-to-week per coach Ben Johnson. Same hamstring as prior injury. Tyson Bagent backup.
items.implication: Miss time; Bagent likely starts. Bears offense changes.

items.text: Giants WR Malik Nabers questionable to return with shoulder injury during MNF, then returned to the game.
items.implication: Available rest of game; monitor for lingering effects.

items.text: Colts WR Alec Pierce aggravated surgically repaired heel; rehab not surgery preferred. Out several weeks, possible IR, midseason return if well.
items.opportunity: Colts WR targets redistribute (Pittman already out prior).

items.text: Bucky Irving separating from Kenny Gainwell: out-snapped 51-23, carries 17-2, routes 22-12. Through 2 weeks opportunities 36-12. Tucker active but 0 snaps.
items.implication: Lead back role solidifying for Irving.
items.opportunity: High snap/route/carry share; start with confidence.

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson lost another fumble (7th in 31 games), punished with playing time. NE needs TreVeyon Henderson explosiveness often, especially with AJ Brown out.
items.why: Fumble punishment + weapon need with Brown absent.
items.implication: Henderson role expansion likely even without fumbles.

items.text: DeVonta Smith RIDE OR DIE: target shares 27%/38% first two games; leads WRs in expected PPR points.
items.why: Elite target share and expected points model.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) officially ACTIVE; optimism confirmed, played with flak potential.
items.why: Improved, practiced, bullish reports; no elevation of other WR.
items.implication: In lineup despite docks possible; full or near role.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey (hamstring) inactive; grab Jonah Coleman as beneficiary.
With Puka out, pivot to Parkinson (flex) or WRs Malachi Fields then Konata Mumpford.
items.why: Anyone's guess on attack without Nacua.

items.implication: Avoid or fade despite volume potential.
items.conflict: Volume may exist but efficiency tanks value.
